svg.title: Escalation: the helper does its part and hands the rest back to you
svg.desc: You ask helper-1, alone on the channel, to convert 3 metres to centimetres and to book a meeting room. The conversion is its work; the booking is not. It escalates once with ask_user: ESCALATE: done: 300 centimetres; left: the meeting room, and the conversation waits for you. In p22-b you answer in that conversation with a conversion inside its role; it reaches helper-1 framed with its escalation, and it passes; asha then tells you no agent could answer, naming helper-1 as passed.
svg.text: Convert 3 metres to centimetres, then book a meeting room for 3 pm.
output (asks): ESCALATE: done: … 300 …; left: … meeting room …
? helper-1 is waiting for your answer — the conversation waits
p22-b · conversation=<id>: Also convert 5 metres to centimetres.
framed "The user answered … What you asked them: ESCALATE …"
No agent could answer this: helper-1 passed
